newsitem.title: USA: Household to redeem cumulative preferred.
newsitem.headline: Household to redeem cumulative preferred.

text.p: Household International Inc said Monday its board authorized the redemption of all outstanding shares of its 9-1/2 percent cumulative preferred stock, Series 1991-A, at $100 per share, plus dividends equal to $0.058056 per depositary hare.
The redemption is set for January 23, 1997.
A depositary share represents ownership of one-tenth of a full share of the 9-1/2 percent preferred stock, Series 1991-A.
The consumer finance services company said there are 550,000 shares (5.5 million depositary shares) of the 9-1/2 percent preferred, Series 1991-A, outstanding.
